what: Generate a smooth centerline with a flat interaction segment — generate_centerline
title: Generate a smooth centerline with a flat interaction segment — generate_centerline
text: Assembles single reference mean-pathway integrating tangent-angle field arc length. central interaction segment exactly straight interaction_length units; two equal arms bend smoothly (C1) angle (radians). result already parametrized curvilinear arc length discretized onto n_points equally spaced points (via fiber::reparametrize()).

title: Generate a smooth centerline with a flat interaction segment — generate_centerline
code: generate_centerline(   angle = 0.5,   arm_length = 1,   interaction_length = 2,   rotation = 0,   vertical_bend = 0,   n_points = 1000L )

title: Generate a smooth centerline with a flat interaction segment — generate_centerline
text: angle Bending angle (radians) reached arm. Bounded (-pi/2, pi/2). arm_length Length (output units) straight run bending arms lead flat central segment. Together interaction_length sets far arms extend. interaction_length Length flat central (straight) part centreline, units output points. rotation Rotation (radians) applied whole centreline vertical (Y) axis generation. Defaults 0. vertical_bend Optional bend angle (radians) applied xy-plane (towards z), centreline can tile truly 3-D fascicle. Defaults 0 (planar centreline). n_points Number equally spaced points grid (curvilinear arc length). Defaults 1000.

title: Generate a smooth centerline with a flat interaction segment — generate_centerline
text: n_points x 3 numeric matrix column names X, Y, Z giving arc-length-parametrized centreline.

title: master: a Multivariate Axonal Simulator for Tractography Evaluation — master-package
text: reference centerline (functional mean pathway) assembled central straight interaction segment smooth bending arms (generate_centerline()); centerline discretized onto equally spaced grid curvilinear arc length (reparametrize_3D_curve()); individual axons drawn centerline plus zero-mean functional random field: coordinate expanded B-spline basis whose Gaussian coefficients carry exponential autocorrelation (create_axons()). title: Simulate a fascicle scenario as a fiber::bundle_set — simulate_scenario
text: configuration One "bending", "fanning", "merging", "kissing", "crossing". n_axons Number streamlines (per bundle two-bundle configurations, total "bending" "fanning"). angle Bending angle (radians), shared geometry parameter. arm_length Length bending arm, shared geometry parameter. interaction_length Flat interaction length, shared geometry parameter. variance Coefficient variance controlling bundle diameter. autocorrelation Correlation rate (space independent coherent streamlines). n_basis Number B-spline coefficients per coordinate. n_points Number points per centreline arc-length reparametrization. separation Separation mean pathways two-bundle configurations ("merging", "kissing", "crossing"). seed Optional integer seed full reproducibility.

title: Simulate a fascicle scenario as a fiber::bundle_set — simulate_scenario
text: fiber::bundle_set one (bending, fanning) two (merging, kissing, crossing) named bundles.

title: Simulate a fascicle scenario as a fiber::bundle_set — simulate_scenario
text: "bending": single bundle whose mean pathway bends (generate_centerline()). "fanning": single bundle diverges two branches fork; half axons follow one branch, half (axon splits). "merging": two bundles start apart run together. "kissing": two bundles meet, travel together, part. "crossing": two bundles whose mean pathways touch point continue; streamlines interlace without fusion.

title: Simulate a fascicle scenario as a fiber::bundle_set — simulate_scenario
code: st <- simulate_scenario("crossing", n_axons = 10, seed = 1) fiber::is_bundle_set(st)      # TRUE #> [1] TRUE st@n_bundles                  # 2 #> [1] 2

what: Smooth C1 interpolation of control points over a station grid — smoothstep_interp
title: Smooth C1 interpolation of control points over a station grid — smoothstep_interp
text: Interpolates control values given station abscissae stations onto grid s using smoothstep ramp t^2 (3 - 2 t) (C1: value slope agree every station). Values first station equal first control value; values last equal last. ramp used generate_centerline(), extracted station tables can drive smoothly-varying field (twist psi, widths W, per-parcel positions).

text: s Numeric grid abscissae (typically arc-length fractions [0, 1]). stations Numeric station abscissae, strictly increasing, range(stations) covering range(s) recommended. vals Numeric control values, one per station (length stations).

title: Smooth C1 interpolation of control points over a station grid — smoothstep_interp
text: Numeric vector, length s.

title: Smooth C1 interpolation of control points over a station grid — smoothstep_interp
code: s <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 101) psi <- smoothstep_interp(s, c(0, 0.5, 1), c(0, pi / 2, pi)) psi[1]        # 0 #> [1] 0 psi[101]      # pi #> [1] 3.141593

title: master 0.0.0.9000
text: New module R/pyramid.R implements per-bundle pyramidal-tract model recorded DECISIONS.qmd (D8): simulate_pyramidal_tract() — one hemisphere’s pyramidal tract fiber::bundle_set five per-body-part bundles (leg, trunk, arm, hand, face). pyt_defaults() — full D8 parameter table (stations, somatotopic q/r offsets, cross-section widths, twist, decussation perturbation controls). pyt_stations() — anatomical station grid (cortex → cord) fractions mm depths. smoothstep_interp() — exported C1 smoothstep interpolation helper, extracted centerline machinery public reuse. Geometry highlights (validated numerically): Parcels form contiguous somatotopic fan cortex, funnel internal capsule, rotate crus–midbrain, re-sort medial–lateral cord. Decussation per-streamline +1 → −1 C1 sign flip (cross controls) optional posterior detour; crossed fibers land contralateral, uncrossed stay ipsilateral, two hemispheres interlace medullary crossing. face parcel corticobulbar: terminates pons (fewer arc-length samples, term_station = "pons") crossed branch terminating bilaterally. Per-stream metadata (parcel, branch, hemisphere) lifted bundle level flows rtists::plot3d() tooltips. Axon spread rescaled local section half-width, bundles read narrow contiguous clouds (~1.6 mm RMS cortex, ~0.3 mm cord) instead hairline strokes; zero-mean (ground-truth pathway) property preserved. create_axons() gained ... caller-supplied per-stream labels stored streamline_data (bundle_id, plus extras).
